name: Fiche example — plain cross-sectional momentum (long leaders)
rationale: A minimal, worked cross-sectional momentum reference (paired with the authoring fiche, docs/AUTHORING.md). Mechanism: at each bar close, rank every screened instrument by its N-day return; the relative-strength LEADERS (top percentile) tend to keep outperforming the laggards at a weekly-to-monthly horizon — the cross-sectional momentum premium documented since Jegadeesh-Titman (1993) and replicated on liquid crypto. The xsec_momentum_rank feature is a point-in-time percentile [0,1] of ret_Nd over the universe present at that bar (no survivorship look-ahead). Entry: rank above a fitted top-rank floor AND realized vol below a fitted ceiling (momentum bleeds in crash/whipsaw regimes). Exit: rank drops below a fitted exit floor (leadership lost) or the stop/take/time-stop fires. This is the PLAIN single-stop/take version — exactly what paper and live execute today (no multi-TP, trailing, or meta-label, which are backtest-only; see the SKILL toolbox matrix). No magic numbers — every threshold is a ParamRef in param_space.
catalyst: Cross-sectional momentum leadership: relative-strength leaders outperform laggards at the weekly-monthly horizon.
